# Software Design {#sec-en-design}

[🇩🇪 Auf Deutsch lesen](../de/design.html){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-secondary style="float:right"}

This chapter covers the internal design decisions, class structures, and
invariants of both implementations.

## Design Principles

The project follows these overarching guidelines:

1. **Cache-first**: Every FUSE operation checks the cache first. The Drive API
   is only contacted on a miss or expired TTL.
2. **No lock during HTTP**: `cache_mutex_` (C++) and DashMap shard locks
   (Rust) are **released** before any API call.
3. **No exceptions across FUSE boundaries** (C++): All callbacks wrap their
   body in `try/catch` and return POSIX error codes.
4. **No `unsafe`** (Rust): All `unsafe` blocks are justified with a
   `// SAFETY:` comment.
5. **Zero warnings**: C++ with `-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror`; Rust with
   `#![deny(warnings)]` and `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`.

## C++ Implementation

### Class Diagram

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-en-cpp-classes
%%| fig-cap: "C++ class diagram"
classDiagram
    class Auth {
        -string client_id_
        -string client_secret_
        -string access_token_
        -string refresh_token_
        -long token_expiry_
        -mutex mutex_
        +Auth(client_id, client_secret)
        +authenticate() bool
        +getAccessToken() string
        +isTokenValid() bool
        +refreshToken() bool
        -startAuthFlow() bool
        -waitForCallback() bool
        -exchangeCodeForTokens() bool
        -saveTokens() void
        -loadTokens() bool
    }

    class GClient {
        -shared_ptr~Auth~ auth_
        +GClient(auth)
        +listFiles(parent_id) DirListing
        +revalidateDir(id, etag) optional~DirListing~
        +getFileMetadata(id) FileInfo
        +downloadFile(id) string
        +uploadFile(name, data, parent) string
        +deleteFile(id) bool
        +getStartPageToken() string
        +pollChanges(token) ChangeList
    }

    class FuseOps {
        -shared_ptr~GClient~ client_
        -shared_mutex cache_mutex_
        -unordered_map path_to_id_cache_
        -unordered_map metadata_cache_
        -unordered_map file_content_cache_
        -unordered_map dir_cache_
        -mutex file_registry_mutex_
        -unordered_map file_mutexes_
        -FuseOps* instance_$
        +FuseOps(client)
        +getFuseOperations()$ fuse_operations
        +invalidateDirCache(parent_id) void
        -getattr(path, stbuf, fi)$ int
        -readdir(path, buf, filler, …)$ int
        -read(path, buf, size, off, fi)$ int
        +setInstance(instance)$ void
    }

    class FileInfo {
        +string id
        +string name
        +string mimeType
        +size_t size
        +string modifiedTime
        +bool isFolder
    }

    class DirListing {
        +vector~FileInfo~ files
        +string etag
    }

    Auth <-- GClient : uses
    GClient <-- FuseOps : holds (shared_ptr)
    GClient ..> FileInfo : returns
    GClient ..> DirListing : returns
```

### Memory Ownership

All component instances are managed via `std::shared_ptr`:

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-en-cpp-ownership
%%| fig-cap: "Memory ownership (C++)"
graph LR
    main["main()"]
    auth["shared_ptr&lt;Auth&gt;"]
    gclient["shared_ptr&lt;GClient&gt;"]
    fuseops["unique_ptr&lt;FuseOps&gt;<br/>(Singleton)"]

    main -->|creates| auth
    main -->|creates| gclient
    gclient -->|holds| auth
    main -->|creates| fuseops
    fuseops -->|holds| gclient
    fuseops -->|FuseOps::instance_| fuseops
```

### Locking Hierarchy (C++)

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-en-cpp-locking
%%| fig-cap: "Locking hierarchy"
graph TD
    A["cache_mutex_ (shared_mutex)"]
    B["file_registry_mutex_ (mutex)"]
    C["file_mutexes_[id] (mutex)"]
    D["Auth::mutex_ (mutex)"]

    A -->|"shared_lock: getattr/readdir/read (cache hit)"| ReadOp["read operation"]
    A -->|"unique_lock: cache write"| WriteOp["write operation"]
    B -->|"lookup / insert per-file mutex"| C
    D -->|"getAccessToken / refreshToken"| TokenOp["token operation"]

    note1["Order: always release cache_mutex_<br/>before acquiring file_mutexes_"]
    note2["Never hold cache_mutex_<br/>during an HTTP call"]
```

::: {.callout-important}
**Locking invariant**: `cache_mutex_` must be **released** before any HTTP
call. Violating this invariant causes deadlocks when `Auth::mutex_` is also
held.
:::

### Error Handling (C++)

```cpp
// Pattern for all FUSE callbacks:
static int getattr(const char* path, struct stat* stbuf,
                   struct fuse_file_info* fi) {
    try {
        // … implementation …
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        spdlog::error("getattr failed: {}", e.what());
        return -EIO;
    }
}
```

### ObjectManager

`ObjectManager` is the **sole** authoritative store for all cached data. It
has no knowledge of the Drive API or the QueueManager.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-en-object-manager
%%| fig-cap: "ObjectManager — internal structure"
classDiagram
    class ObjectManager {
        -AtomicU64 next_ino
        -DashMap ino_to_id: u64→String
        -DashMap id_to_ino: String→u64
        -DashMap id_to_info: String→FileInfo
        -DashMap dir_cache: String→DirEntry
        -ContentCache content_cache
        -DashMap name_index: (u64,String)→u64
        +get_or_create_ino(drive_id) u64
        +store_dir(parent_id, listing, etag) void
        +get_dir_files(parent_id) Option~Vec~FileInfo~~
        +is_dir_stale(parent_id) bool
        +is_dir_invalid(parent_id) bool
        +invalidate_dir(parent_id) void
        +store_metadata(id, info) void
        +get_metadata(ino) Option~FileInfo~
        +store_content(id, bytes) void
        +get_content(id) Option~Vec~u8~~
        +lookup_name(parent_ino, name) Option~u64~
    }

    class ContentCache {
        -Mutex~ContentCacheInner~ inner
        -u64 max_bytes
        +get(file_id) Option~Vec~u8~~
        +insert(file_id, data) void
    }

    class DirEntry {
        +Vec~FileInfo~ files
        +String etag
        +DirState state
        +SystemTime fetched_at
    }

    class DirState {
        <<enumeration>>
        Fresh
        Stale
        Invalid
    }

    ObjectManager --> ContentCache
    ObjectManager --> DirEntry
    DirEntry --> DirState
```

### QueueManager

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-en-queue-manager
%%| fig-cap: "QueueManager — deduplication logic"
sequenceDiagram
    participant F as FuseOps
    participant QM as QueueManager
    participant T as tracking: DashMap
    participant W as Worker
    participant OM as ObjectManager

    F->>QM: enqueue_and_wait(FetchDir("abc"), High)
    QM->>T: entry("abc") exists?

    alt Task already known (queued or in-flight)
        T-->>QM: yes → attach TaskCompletion
        W-->>QM: result (Condvar signal)
        QM-->>F: TaskResult
    else New task
        T-->>QM: no → insert + send
        QM->>W: channel.send(Task)
        W->>OM: GClient::listFiles → store_dir
        W->>T: tracking.remove("abc") → notify all completions
        QM-->>F: TaskResult
    end
```

#### Task Priorities

| Priority | Trigger | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `High` | User-triggered FUSE operation | `lookup`, `readdir`, `read` |
| `Normal` | Background directory prefetch | Root listing on startup, subdirectories |
| `Low` | Background file prefetch | Small files ≤ 512 KiB |

Workers check the HIGH queue first (non-blocking), then NORMAL, then block on
a `select!` across all three.

### DupMapping

When Google Drive allows multiple files with the same name in the same
directory (which is not possible locally), `DupMapping` resolves the conflict:

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-en-dup-mapping
%%| fig-cap: "DupMapping — name collision resolution"
flowchart TD
    A["Drive listing:<br/>'report.pdf' (id=abc)<br/>'report.pdf' (id=xyz)"]
    B{"Name collision?"}
    C["First entry: 'report.pdf'"]
    D["Second entry:<br/>'report (2).pdf'"]
    E["Persistence:<br/>~/.gdrive-fuse-rs/dup-mapping"]

    A --> B
    B -- no --> C
    B -- yes --> D
    D -->|"save mapping"| E
    E -->|"restore on restart"| D
```

## Implementation Comparison

| Aspect | C++ | Rust |
|---|---|---|
| Language | C++20 | Rust 2021 |
| FUSE library | libfuse3 (direct) | fuser 0.14 |
| HTTP client | cpr (libcurl) | reqwest (blocking) |
| Cache locking | `std::shared_mutex` | `dashmap::DashMap` (16 shards) |
| Token locking | `std::mutex` | `parking_lot::RwLock` |
| Task queue | – | crossbeam-channel (3 priorities) |
| Content cache | `std::unordered_map` | LRU/FIFO, byte-bounded (1 GiB) |
| Error model | Exceptions + POSIX codes | `anyhow::Result` + POSIX codes |
| Duplicate names | – | DupMapping (persistent) |
| Startup prefetch | – | Yes (parallel workers) |

## Security Considerations

- OAuth2 tokens and client secrets are **never logged**.
- `credentials.json` and `.gdrive_tokens.json` are in `.gitignore`.
- All API responses are checked for HTTP status code **before** JSON parsing.
- No `system()` / `popen()` — no shell injection attack surface.
- The CSRF state parameter in the OAuth2 flow protects against open-redirect
  attacks.

## Code Style

### C++

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Formatting | `.clang-format` (LLVM base, 100-column limit, 4-space indent) |
| Include guards | `#pragma once` |
| Include order | project → third-party → standard library |
| Pointers | No raw owning pointers; `shared_ptr` / `unique_ptr` |
| Return annotation | `[[nodiscard]]` wherever ignoring the return is always a bug |
| String parameters | `std::string_view` for read-only |
| Documentation | Doxygen `/** */` for public API |

### Rust

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Edition | 2021 |
| Linting | `#![deny(warnings)]`; `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` |
| Error handling | `?` operator; `anyhow::Result` |
| Unsafe | No `unsafe` without `// SAFETY:` comment |
| Formatting | `cargo fmt` (default settings) |

## Extensibility — Adding a New Client

The monorepo is designed for new language implementations:

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-en-new-client
%%| fig-cap: "Steps to add a new client"
flowchart TD
    A["Create clients/&lt;lang&gt;/<br/>with native build system"]
    B["Implement the interface:<br/>list_files · revalidate_dir<br/>get_file_metadata · download_file<br/>getattr · readdir · read<br/>OAuth2 + token refresh"]
    C["Add Makefile targets:<br/>build-&lt;lang&gt; · run-&lt;lang&gt;<br/>lint-&lt;lang&gt; · format-&lt;lang&gt;"]
    D["Update copilot-instructions.md<br/>under 'Language-specific notes'"]

    A --> B --> C --> D
```
